## Research interests

Democratic legitimacy and procedural fairness; public opinion and political behaviour; AI in public administration; deliberation and democratic innovation; survey methodology and election forecasting.

## Methods

Survey experiments, deliberative polls, quantitative analysis, and reproducible research with R and Quarto.

## Teaching

Quantitative methods in the social sciences and the American political system.
